test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following care and maintenance of a marking table is INCORRECT?

options.text: The marking table should be protected from rust.
After use, the marking table should be cleaned with a soft cloth.
The marking table should be protected from damage.
The surface of the marking table should not be given a thin layer of oil.

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 4__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Care and maintenance of a marking table:__
 
• The marking table should be protected from rust.
 
• After use, the marking table should be cleaned with a soft cloth.
 
• The marking table should be protected from damage.
 
• The surface of the marking table should be given a thin layer of oil to prevent rust.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Oil Layer:**
 
 
• A thin layer of oil acts as a protective barrier against moisture.
 
• This helps in preventing rust and maintaining the table's longevity.
